summary.tldr: Raises the Old Age Security full pension for seniors 65 and older and changes the income exemption used to calculate the Guaranteed Income Supplement.
what_it_does: Increases the full monthly Old Age Security pension for people 65 and older, and sets the full amount at $756.32 for the payment quarter starting January 1, 2023.
Raises the employment and self-employment earnings exemption used to calculate the Guaranteed Income Supplement from $5,000 to $6,500 for months after June 2023.
Increases some deferred partial monthly pensions by 0.6% for each month between when a person becomes eligible and when their application is approved.
Changes how certain pension-related amounts are rounded and updates the rule for calculating the “pension equivalent” amount.
summary.background: It amends the Old Age Security Act.
